name: Quarry-Spawned Tendua
journal_prompt: A manticore variant that haunts ancient stone quarries, its stone-hard fur blending into the weathered rock walls.
appearance: A heavy, wingless manticore of the ancient Permian simian-felid line, its stone-furred frame made of rough sandstone and river gravel. It has dexterous, ape-like forepaws, a segmented basalt scorpion tail, and a hauntingly expressive human face capable of subtle feeling and of mocking speech.
